description_for_human: Cross-system impact evidence for a change; approvers only when evidence shows risk; full audit.
description_for_model: Use to open and review an impact-analysis trial for a cross-system change (routine low-risk changes need no approver; risky ones resolve required approver roles). submit_change opens a trial and returns the impact, risk, plan (or safe alternative), and required approvers (run_mode="analyze" makes it an impact check that never executes and reports the would-be approvers); get_trial returns the full record; cast_verdict records a decision (use accept_alternative for the safe alternative); send_for_approval/withdraw_change/decide drive the separation-of-duties approval flow; list_pending_approvals is the approver's queue; acknowledge_outcome lets the requester confirm a concluded trial's outcome; get_status returns the lifecycle state.

functions.name: submit_change
functions.description: Open a trial for a risky change; returns the trial summary (status, risk, plan, verdict options).

functions.name: get_status
functions.description: Return the current lifecycle status of a trial.

functions.name: get_trial
functions.description: Return the full trial record: change, impact, options, risk, quorum, verdict, results.

functions.name: cast_verdict
functions.description: Record a reviewer's verdict and resume the trial; idempotent per thread and key.

functions.name: send_for_approval
functions.description: Requester sends the trial to its approvers with a mandatory note.

functions.name: withdraw_change
functions.description: Requester gives up the change instead of sending it for approval.

functions.name: decide
functions.description: An authorized approver approves, or rejects with a note; the requester cannot self-approve.

functions.name: list_pending_approvals
functions.description: List trials awaiting the caller's approval (authorized role, not their own requests).

functions.name: acknowledge_outcome
functions.description: Requester confirms the concluded outcome so requester, approver, and audit trail are demonstrably synced.
